Senses.Explanation: The affinity of gruel and rice names the institutional food relation by which a resident has been sustained in the assembly; cases invoke it autobiographically or critically as an obligation created by daily provisions. The phrase concerns the monastic sustenance relation, not a recipe or the foods in isolation.
